title: Senior Data Analyst
description: We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst with strong SQL and Python skills. The candidate should have experience with Snowflake, Tableau, dbt, data analysis, dashboard development, and working with cross-functional teams. Experience with AWS and modern data platforms is preferred. Candidates should have 3+ years of relevant experience.

title: Analytics Engineer
description: We are looking for an Analytics Engineer with 3+ years of experience in data analytics and data engineering. Strong SQL and Python skills are required. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with Snowflake, dbt, AWS, ETL pipelines, data modeling, and BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI. Experience building reliable data transformations and working with business stakeholders is important.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description: We are hiring a Senior Data Analyst to work with product and financial data. Candidates should have 4+ years of experience, strong SQL, Python, and Excel skills, and experience with Power BI. Experience with financial analytics, statistics, experimentation, and A/B testing is required. Familiarity with Azure and Databricks is preferred.

title: Analytics Engineer
description: The Analytics Engineering team at DoorDash is embedded within the Analytics and Data Engineering organizations and is responsible for building internal data products that scale decision-making across business teams and drive efficiency in operations. As an Analytics Engineer, the candidate will build and scale data foundations that enable fast, reliable, and actionable insights and work closely with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Software Engineers, Product Managers, and Operators. Responsibilities include collaborating with data scientists, data engineers, and business stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into data requirements; identifying business questions and generating insights; leading development of data products and self-service tools; building and maintaining canonical datasets using high-volume reliable ETL/ELT pipelines and data lake and data warehousing concepts; designing metrics and visualizations using tools such as Tableau, Sigma, and Mode; and maintaining high data integrity standards. Requirements include 5+ years of experience in business intelligence, analytics engineering, data engineering, or a similar role; strong SQL; proficiency in Python or Scala; expertise with reporting and visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Sigma; familiarity with database fundamentals including S3, Trino, Hive, and Spark; SQL performance tuning; data quality checks; excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills; and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment. Nice-to-have experience includes Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, Airflow, Dagster, dbt, and experimentation concepts such as A/B testing.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description: The Senior Data Analyst is responsible for implementing and maintaining digital employee experience and workplace technology analytics to continuously measure and improve employee experience and adoption. The role involves working on strategic, highly visible projects with employee technology and adjacent functions, designing and implementing workplace technology data and analytics ecosystems, and transforming data assets to enhance digital dexterity and support an AI-enabled workforce. The candidate will architect and build analytics-optimized data models in Snowflake using star schema and dimensional modeling; design, develop, and orchestrate robust data pipelines using Snowflake, Snowpipe, dbt, Python, and Apache Airflow; integrate Snowflake with Microsoft Fabric and OneLake; build and maintain enterprise semantic models in Fabric and Power BI using Direct Lake and advanced DAX; develop AI-ready data backbones supporting predictive analytics, machine learning, and LLM-based use cases; partner with analytics, data science, and business teams to enable AI/ML consumption through semantic models; analyze diverse datasets and support experimentation and AI-driven insights; design analytical frameworks and reusable datasets; provide technical leadership and drive initiatives end-to-end; and communicate effectively with engineering, analytics, product, and executive stakeholders. Candidates should have a minimum of 6+ years of corporate experience in data engineering, enterprise analytics, or related technical roles. Strong hands-on expertise with Snowflake, SnowSQL, Snowpipe, advanced SQL, and Python is required. Proven experience with Microsoft Fabric, Lakehouses, OneLake, Notebooks, Power BI, enterprise semantic modeling, and advanced DAX is required. Candidates should have deep experience designing dimensional and semantic data models for enterprise reporting, analytics, and AI/ML use cases; strong proficiency with dbt and Apache Airflow for modular, CI/CD-enabled production-grade data pipelines; experience delivering end-to-end analytics data journeys from operational systems through transformation, data lakes, and enterprise warehouses; exposure to AI/ML platforms, predictive analytics, and generative AI use cases including preparing data for LLM consumption; experience designing scalable analytics platforms and governed self-service analytics; understanding of data strategy and governance; and working knowledge of Power BI and Tableau. The role operates in a hybrid work model and involves collaboration across a global organization.

The most forward-thinking marketers choose StackAdapt to orchestrate high-impact campaigns across programmatic advertising and marketing channels. StackAdapt’s Advertising Technology team is looking for a highly analytical and results-oriented Product Data Analyst to drive product and performance insights for our Mobile App User Acquisition program. In this role, you will work closely with Product, Machine Learning, Business Intelligence, Data Engineering and business teams to define performance metrics, analyze campaign and product trends and translate complex data into actionable recommendations. The primary focus of the role is product analytics, but we are looking for someone who can go beyond one-off analysis. Candidates with experience in analytics engineering or data engineering will be strongly preferred, particularly those who can build reliable datasets, data pipelines, dashboards and automated analytical workflows. The ideal candidate has experience working with mobile app advertising, performance marketing or another data-intensive product environment. They should be comfortable working across structured and unstructured data sources and independently taking an analytical problem from initial question through data sourcing, analysis, visualization and recommendation. We are also looking for someone with an AI-first mindset. Candidates who have experience using AI to accelerate analysis, automate repetitive workflows or build internal agents and reusable skills will be given preference. title: Analytics Engineer
description: Back to jobs New Analytics Engineer Remote, United States Apply Analytics Engineer, Strategic Accounts Customer Solutions Group · Full-Time · Remote, United States You'll embed with one enterprise client's growth team as a key technical partner. The work is hands-on SQL: building audiences, editing scripts, digging into data discrepancies, and supporting live email and direct mail campaigns. You'll learn their business deeply and own the data work end to end, with room to make it yours: The team is moving to a new cloud environment this fall, so you can rebuild the recurring work from scratch: automate the manual steps, clean up the pipelines, and design the processes the way they should be. What starts as running the day-to-day can grow into owning how the whole system works. This work and team moves fast, running on weekly recurring deadlines, with quick turnarounds. If you like significant ownership and steady pressure over a slow, tidy queue, you'll do well here. What You'll Do Build and edit SQL to power audience building and email and direct mail campaigns. Work directly with a single enterprise client to understand their business needs, data landscape, and roadblocks. Design and build scalable data models that support the client's analytical and operational goals. Drive improvements to internal workflows and tooling to increase efficiency and repeatability. Serve as a thought partner for client stakeholders, guiding technical and strategic data decisions. Investigate data discrepancies, analyze deltas between tables, and get into the weeds to answer real questions for the client. What You Bring You are excellent at SQL, with 2+ years of hands-on experience in a production environment. This is the most important skill for the role, so you write, read, and debug complex queries with ease every day. You have hands-on experience querying cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or Databricks) You have a solid understanding of data pipelines and data engineering concepts (ETL/reverse ETL, event streaming, data modeling). You communicate well with both technical and non-technical partners, and you enjoy working across both. You stay responsive and calm under tight, recurring deadlines. Quick turnarounds and shifting priorities energize you rather than wear you down. About GrowthLoop GrowthLoop built the first composable CDP, helping marketers leverage live, first-party data from their cloud warehouse to launch highly targeted campaigns. That composable foundation gave way to the Compound Marketing Engine, an evolution of the composable CDP that drives compound growth by using agentic AI to accelerate the marketing cycle. Now, we’re building what comes next: an agentic system that uses causality data to find the actions that actually improve customer outcomes and gets smarter with every campaign cycle. Founder-led, we’re partnering with the world’s most innovative brands to close the loop between people, data, and AI. Enterprise marketing teams at Google, Costco, Ford, and Whirlpool (to name a few) choose GrowthLoop to launch smarter, more personalized marketing programs that compound growth with every campaign. About You Moving at our pace brings change, complexity, ambiguity, and a little chaos. You're comfortable being uncomfortable, and you'd rather own a hard problem than wait for a clean one. You have high agency: you find the gap and close it, and you turn decisions into outcomes, not more meetings. You measure your work by whether the customer actually wins, and you'd rather prove impact than claim it. You make the people around you sharper, and the team winning matters more to you than being right. You give direct, honest feedback (kindly), and you're curious about damn near everything, because time not spent learning feels wasted. You treat your part of the work like an owner, deliver reliably, build skills fast, and pitch in beyond your lane when it moves things forward. Compensation & Details The on-target-earnings for this role are $110,000 to $120,000 USD. Total compensation includes equity and additional opportunities for variable compensation - we came up bootstrapped and have scaled with discipline, and we share that ownership with those helping us build. Please note that we can only consider candidates for the Analytics Engineer role who are based in the United States and authorized to work without visa sponsorship. Final base salary decisions will be based on a variety of non-discriminatory factors unique to each candidate, such as the individual’s skill set, depth of experience, and qualifications. What We Offer Rewards Spot bonuses for major milestones and product feature launches Clear opportunities for career progression and cross-functional collaboration Equity in GrowthLoop, so you share in the value you help create. Flexible, Remote-First Work Remote-first culture with team members and leaders across North America and beyond, with strong communities in New York, San Francisco, and Toronto. Flexible, goal-based work style Flexible Time off Monthly, company-wide Recharge Days to truly unplug Annual home office stipend to support your workspace Comprehensive Benefits 100% company-paid medical coverage for individual employees with strong dependent contributions, including dental & vision coverage Full health, dental, vision, life, and disability coverage for Canadian employees (fully employer-paid) 401(k) or RRSP (Canada) Program with Generous Company Match Learn and Grow Quarterly Hackathons to focus on team passion projects Annual professional development stipend Work directly with a world-class executive team A learners’ mindset culture GrowthLoop is an Equal Opportunity Employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. title: Analytics Engineer Sênior
description: Voltar para vagas Novo Analytics Engineer Sênior BRASIL, SÃO PAULO Apply COMO SEU TRABALHO PODE TRANSFORMAR O MUNDO! Missão da área: Estamos à procura de um(a) Analytics Engineer Sênior para atuar na construção e evolução de soluções de dados robustas, escaláveis e confiáveis, conectando necessidades de negócio a soluções técnicas de alto impacto. Esperamos que este profissional tenha visão end-to-end do ciclo de vida dos dados, atuando de forma autônoma na arquitetura, qualidade, performance e sustentabilidade das soluções. Também será referência técnica para o time e parceiro de diferentes áreas, contribuindo para decisões que considerem impactos cross, trade-offs entre velocidade, qualidade e custo, e evolução contínua do ecossistema de dados. Aqui suas responsabilidades serão: Projetar, desenvolver e evoluir pipelines e soluções de dados resilientes e escaláveis, considerando todo o ciclo de vida dos dados, desde a origem até o consumo. Garantir qualidade, confiabilidade e observabilidade dos dados, implementando validações, testes, monitoramento, alertas e estratégias de reprocessamento e recuperação. Atuar na otimização sistêmica das soluções, identificando gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria em pipelines, cargas e padrões de consumo, equilibrando performance, custo, escalabilidade e manutenibilidade. Liderar tecnicamente iniciativas de dados end-to-end, articulando com diferentes times e disciplinas, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas e dando visibilidade sobre decisões, riscos e impactos. Ser referência técnica para o time e para outras áreas, compartilhando conhecimento, realizando revisões de código e modelagem, apoiando decisões técnicas e contribuindo para o desenvolvimento de profissionais menos experientes Qualificações que você precisa ter: Experiência mínima de 5 anos na construção e evolução de pipelines e soluções de dados escaláveis e confiáveis. SQL avançado, com domínio de funções complexas e otimização de consultas. Experiência com Data Warehousing, especialmente Amazon Redshift. Experiência com Python/PySpark para manipulação e transformação de grandes volumes de dados. Conhecimento em arquitetura e otimização de pipelines, considerando performance, custo, escalabilidade, qualidade e sustentabilidade técnica. Experiência com monitoramento, qualidade e confiabilidade de dados, incluindo alertas, validações e estratégias de recuperação. Capacidade de comunicar decisões técnicas, atuar de forma cross-funcional e traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções de dados. How do you know if you have a disability? A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to: Alcohol or other substance use disorder (not currently using drugs illegally) Autoimmune disorder, for example, lupus, fibromyalgia, rheumatoid arthritis, HIV/AIDS Blind or low vision Cancer (past or present) Cardiovascular or heart disease Celiac disease Cerebral palsy Deaf or serious difficulty hearing Diabetes Disfigurement, for example, disfigurement caused by burns, wounds, accidents, or congenital disorders Epilepsy or other seizure disorder Gastrointestinal disorders, for example, Crohn's Disease, irritable bowel syndrome Intellectual or developmental disability Mental health conditions, for example, depression, bipolar disorder, anxiety disorder, schizophrenia, PTSD Missing limbs or partially missing limbs Mobility impairment, benefiting from the use of a wheelchair, scooter, walker, leg brace(s) and/or other supports Nervous system condition, for example, migraine headaches, Parkinson’s disease, multiple sclerosis (MS) Neurodivergence, for example, attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), autism spectrum disorder, dyslexia, dyspraxia, other learning disabilities Partial or complete paralysis (any cause) Pulmonary or respiratory conditions, for example, tuberculosis, asthma, emphysema Short stature (dwarfism) Traumatic brain injury Disability Status Selecionar... description: Back to jobs New Head of Data Engineering & Platform San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States Apply In the early 1970s, Ken Thompson and Dennis Ritchie built Unix around a deceptively simple idea: create small, composable tools that work well together. That philosophy went on to shape modern operating systems, developer tooling, cloud infrastructure, and much of the software we rely on today—not because any individual tool was revolutionary, but because the platform made everyone else more productive. We're looking for a Head of Data Engineering & Platform who can build the data platform that gives Mercury that same leverage—creating a foundation where trusted data is easy for both people and AI systems to discover, understand, and work with. In this role, you'll lead and grow a high-performing team of data engineers responsible for Mercury's core data infrastructure. You'll shape the architecture, tooling, and engineering practices that enable reliable analytics, accelerate product development, and enable the next generation of AI-powered products and internal tools. * Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC. description: Back to jobs New Senior Data Engineer (Must: Informatica) Argentina / Perú Apply Santex is a global Certified B technology company as well as one of North America's fastest-growing companies, according to the Inc. 5000. It’s present in 18 countries and over 100 cities, and headquartered in Argentina with offices in the United States, Mexico, and Peru. Its two service lines — AI Tech Consulting and AI-Optimized Engineering — help organizations comprehensively adopt technology, expand their capabilities, and improve business outcomes at scale. The same approach defines its culture: Santex has 80.4% employee engagement (global average: 21%), 8% annual turnover (tech sector: 20–25%), 9,369 training hours invested in 2025 — more than double the global average —, and a 26.5% year-over-year reduction in carbon footprint, achieving carbon neutrality through offsetting. Santex. A company with purpose and judgment. Yes, it's possible. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any of these factors. We strongly encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Position Summary We are seeking a Senior Informatica Data Engineer to design, develop, and support scalable enterprise data integration solutions across cloud and on-premises environments. This role will be responsible for building and optimizing ETL/ELT pipelines using Informatica technologies, Python, and SQL to support data warehousing, analytics, reporting, and business intelligence initiatives. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in Informatica development, advanced SQL and Python skills, cloud data platforms, and data warehouse architecture, with the ability to lead technical initiatives and mentor junior team members. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain ETL/ELT processes using Informatica PowerCenter and/or Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC/IICS). Build scalable data pipelines integrating data from databases, applications, APIs, cloud platforms, and flat files. Develop and support enterprise data warehouse, data lake, and analytics solutions. Create and maintain Python-based automation, data processing, validation, and monitoring solutions. Develop and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and database integrations. Implement data quality, reconciliation, and governance controls to ensure data accuracy and reliability. Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data integration workflows and platform performance. Partner with Data Architects, BI teams, business stakeholders, and application teams to deliver data solutions aligned with business objectives. Lead design reviews, establish development standards, and mentor junior data engineers. Support cloud modernization and migration initiatives. 8+ years of experience in Data Engineering, ETL/ELT development, or Data Integration. 5+ years of hands-on Informatica development experience, including PowerCenter and/or IDMC/IICS. 3+ years of experience developing data engineering solutions using Python. Strong experience with data warehouse design and dimensional modeling. Advanced SQL development and performance tuning experience. Experience working with large-scale enterprise data environments. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Technical Skills Data Integration Informatica PowerCenter Informatica IDMC / IICS Cloud Data Integration (CDI) ETL / ELT Development Data Quality & Data Governance Programming & Databases Python SQL PySpark (preferred) SQL Server Oracle PostgreSQL Snowflake Cloud & Analytics Platforms Azure, AWS, or GCP Snowflake Microsoft Fabric Azure Data Lake Azure Synapse Databricks DevOps & Automation Git Azure DevOps CI/CD Pipelines REST APIs Shell Scripting Preferred Qualifications Informatica, Azure, or Snowflake certifications. Experience with Databricks, Spark, and modern cloud data architectures. Experience with API-based integrations and workflow orchestration tools. Knowledge of Master Data Management (MDM), metadata management, and data governance frameworks. Experience leading technical projects and mentoring development teams. Success Profile The ideal candidate is a hands-on senior data engineer who brings expertise in Informatica, Python, SQL, and cloud data platforms, while serving as a technical leader capable of delivering scalable, high-quality data solutions that enable enterprise reporting, analytics, and business decision-making.
